notes: Self-declared "cozy adventure game" with the emphasis stated as exploration, which is the Exploration preset almost exactly; the resource collection is for simple crafting with no economy behind it, so no second genre is doing real work and it lands as collectible-nodes rather than as a Survival or Simulation gathering loop. world-open is Adventure's default and reads correctly even at this scale, because the author's compact grove is one contiguous map found in whatever order the player likes; space-bounded would also have routed P0 but describes a space you are held inside rather than one you explore. Added collectible-nodes to the preset for the resources, and read the "environmental obstacles" as the dense forest geometry - deadfall, thickets and boulders channelling the trails - rather than hazard-kill, whose lethal chasms and rapids contradict cozy; since no landform, water or interior is asserted anywhere, the build stays on P0 with no tiered relief. Decided without a user: a single walkable grove crossable in about half a minute, stylized toon dressing, and hidden alcoves as where the better resources sit so exploring pays off.
